messages:
ria (DevEx): Observed a dup-start issue when the app is backgrounded (home button) during an in-flight chunked generate call. Happens reliably on some OEM devices when they aggressively throttle background sockets.

ria (DevEx): Repro: 1) start streaming POST /v1/generate from sampleapp 2) press Home mid-upload 3) wait ~1s 4) reopen app -> server sometimes reports two session-starts for same client-generated session id.

ria (DevEx): Minimal okhttp config we ship:
```kotlin
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES))
  .build()
```

logs:
```
[09:11:02] CLIENT start session=s-901 POST /v1/generate chunked
[09:11:03] OS: app moved to background -> sockets paused
[09:11:03] NETWORK: java.net.SocketException: socket closed
[09:11:03] RETRY attempt=1 for s-901
[09:11:04] CLIENT start session=s-901 POST /v1/generate chunked
```

dan (Android): Likely the same root cause as previous retry issues: our retry path re-executes requests on IOExceptions without checking that the body is one-shot. When the OS closes the socket on background, we catch IOException and resend.

owen (Platform): Short-term fixes: (a) classify streaming endpoints as non-retryable in SDK defaults, (b) change RetryInterceptor to throw on one-shot bodies rather than re-execute, (c) add an SDK helper to attach X-Idempotency-Key if caller wants server dedupe.

ria (DevEx): Proposed quick patch: in RetryInterceptor, before attempting retry, if (req.header("Transfer-Encoding")=="chunked" || req.body?.contentLength()==-1L) { throw ioe } else retry. Also set streaming-client builder to retryOnConnectionFailure(false).

fran (QA): I can reproduce on a Samsung device (Android 13) by hitting Home during upload. I'll add a CI test using adb to background the app and assert server saw only one start. Also will add a flaky-network test variant.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1944 - "Backgrounding app during streaming can trigger retry and duplicate session-start"

owen (Platform): Long-term we should recommend caller-provided idempotency keys and implement server-side dedupe. For now let's land the guard and the CI test.

ria (DevEx): I'll open the PR with the interceptor guard, update docs (Android troubleshooting: backgrounding + streaming), and add the sampleapp regression. Thanks.
